faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions about SeaNeB Solution.

items.a: SeaNeB Solution is a focused framework to help car buyers discover trusted listings and help sellers get high-intent leads in local markets.
Buyers, independent dealers, and local vehicle businesses can all use the platform for discovery, comparison, and direct communication.

items.q: How is this different from aggregator marketplaces?
items.a: The workflow is designed to reduce friction. Users can move from search to contact quickly while businesses keep stronger control over their visibility.

items.q: Can I join as a new seller?
items.a: Yes. Register your business profile, complete verification, and start receiving local discovery traffic.
